title: test(driver-sqlite-wasm): run the persistence suites' temp files on /dev/shm, so a flush's fsync stops waiting on the shard's other suites
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X2kei2ECbgeH2p5LqGYSsPn)_

Fixes #27076

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`driver-sqlite-wasm` 这个包的 vitest 配置把测试进程的 `TMPDIR` 指到可写的 `/dev/shm`（内存盘）；机器上没有 `/dev/shm`（macOS、Windows）就保持原样。只动了 `packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm/vitest.config.ts` 一个文件，产品代码、用例、断言和 5 s 预算都没动。
- **为什么改**：全量测试两次红（10-22 的 39853791549、今天 08:05Z 的 40654333991）都是这个包里写真实数据库文件的落盘用例超时。每次落盘最后都要 `fsync`，而 `fsync` 要排在同一台 CI 机器上其他测试套件的磁盘队列后面，所以本地 30 ms 的用例在分片上能拖到 5 s 以上。用例测的是驱动的落盘语义，不是邻居的磁盘有多忙。
- **风险与回滚**：低。代码路径完全一样（`sync()` 照样调用），只是临时文件落在内存盘上；不发布任何东西（`vitest.config.ts` 不在包的 `files[]` 里）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm/vitest.config.ts`（唯一改动，头部注释写了测量）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm && pnpm exec vitest run`，预期 39 个文件 746 条全过；在用例里打印 `os.tmpdir()` 会看到 `/dev/shm`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。下一次 4 小时全量测试转绿即关卡。

## What changes

`packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm/vitest.config.ts` used to be the bare re-export of `vitest.preset.mts`. It is now a `defineConfig` with two keys:

- `disableConsoleIntercept: true`, restated from the preset: `check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` judges the preset in a config's place only for the bare re-export, so a config with its own key carries the disarm itself (`node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` → `OK: 77 vitest-running package(s)`).
- `env: { TMPDIR: '/dev/shm' }` when `/dev/shm` is writable, `{}` otherwise. Every test file in the package reaches its temp directory through `os.tmpdir()` (`mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), …))`, 9 files), and `os.tmpdir()` reads `TMPDIR` on each call, so no test file changes.

Every other key stays on vitest's defaults, as under the re-export.

### Why the cases were slow (the cause)

The failing case, read from the full job log by the maintainer (card comment 6468136240): `SqliteWasmDriver (file persistence) > should persist data on-write`, 5,026 ms, `Test timed out in 5000ms`, on `Test Core (6/8)`; its sibling `on-disconnect` took 4,236 ms. Run 39853791549 timed out five cases, all on on-write or flush paths (`background-flush-failure` ×3, `returning-persist` `UPDATE … RETURNING`, `durability` atomic write).

Each of those flushes ends in `WasmSqliteConnection.atomicWriteFile`: write a sibling temp file, `handle.sync()`, rename. The case itself is about 30 ms on an idle disk (step probe: create 3, insert 1, flush 4, reopen + find 3, raw 8 KiB `sync()` 1 ms). The time goes to `sync()` waiting behind other processes' writes on the same disk:

| Disk state (4-core box; the 4 persistence files, 29 cases) | `on-write` case | Slowest case | Cases over 1 s | Timeouts |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| idle, `TMPDIR` on the disk (2 runs, base 24351cfe) | 15–39 ms | 0.26 s | 0 | 0 |
| 4 `dd … conv=fsync` writers, `TMPDIR` on the disk (3 runs) | 1,388–3,630 ms | 3.6 s | 7–11 per run | 0 |
| 4 writers, `TMPDIR=/dev/shm` (3 runs) | 12–28 ms | 0.54 s | 0 | 0 |

The same set of cases that went red on CI is the set that inflates under disk load, and only those. CPU load alone does not do it: 8 runs of the whole suite beside 3 busy-loop processes kept every case under 0.6 s.

### Why this is the test's correctness, not a budget

A case whose wall time is set by unrelated suites' disk I/O measures the runner, not the driver. On `/dev/shm` the same code runs, `sync()` and `rename()` included, and every assertion (bytes on disk, atomic rename with no leftover temp file, the serialized flush chain, the failure report and retry) is unchanged. The triage ruling holds: no budget raised, no case skipped, no fixture shrunk, no retry wrapper.

## Tests

<details><summary>Red on the base config, green on this head: 8 fsync writers, alternated, 3 rounds (head 2c4bfcec)</summary>

Base leg: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `env:` line with `env: {}` (the pre-change behaviour: anchor 1 → 0, blob `08fbf987a6e2` → `ea1e118ddf13`; a probe case printed `TMPDIR_SEEN=/tmp` under it and `TMPDIR_SEEN=/dev/shm` on head), ran the four persistence files, then restored (`ok restored: blob == HEAD (08fbf987a6e2) and git diff HEAD is empty`, checked after every round). Head leg: the committed config. All legs under 8 `dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=512 conv=fsync` writers on the same disk, inside one `os-verify-lock` hold (VERDICT command-exit 0, 236 s).

```
base-1  Tests 2 failed | 27 passed (29)   returning-persist UPDATE … RETURNING 6061 ms timeout; returning-persist transaction 7227 ms timeout
head-1  Tests 29 passed (29)              slowest 178 ms
base-2  Tests 2 failed | 27 passed (29)   returning-persist INSERT … RETURNING 6641 ms timeout; driver.test.ts "should persist data on-write" 5358 ms timeout
head-2  Tests 29 passed (29)              slowest 223 ms
base-3  Tests 1 failed | 28 passed (29)   returning-persist UPDATE … RETURNING 6223 ms timeout
head-3  Tests 29 passed (29)              slowest 217 ms
```

Base round 2 reproduces the CI failure exactly (`should persist data on-write`, `Test timed out in 5000ms`).

</details>

<details><summary>Whole package, head 2c4bfcec</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm test` under `os-verify-lock`: VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 39 passed (39)`, `Tests 746 passed (746)`. `/dev/shm` holds no leftover after the run (the suites clean their `mkdtemp` directories as before).

</details>

<details><summary>What was tried before the case was named (base 24351cfe)</summary>

Alone ×2, beside 3 busy-loop CPU burners ×8, and the shard's real whole-package leg (the 10 packages of `Test Core (6/8)`, `turbo run test test:repo --concurrency=4`, `OS_TEST_TIERS=queue`) ×3: all 746/746 green. Those loads were CPU-heavy, not fsync-heavy, which is why none reproduced it.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `/dev/shm` is writable in the cloud container these readings come from; I did not read a GitHub runner's mounts, so the shard's next run is the proof that it is used there. A host without a writable `/dev/shm` keeps its own temp directory, so the config never errors and never changes behaviour there.
- Other packages that fsync real files in tests were not surveyed; this PR is scoped to the package the card names.

## Verification

Local, head `2c4bfcec`, change set `packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm/vitest.config.ts` only.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 42 commands; each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: `42 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need a full workspace build, which this card thread did not run). CI runs both.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone, then 0 after `git fetch --depth=1` of its positive-control commit (48 cases pass).
- Outside the derivation: `node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` → exit 0 (`OK: 77 vitest-running package(s)`); `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm` → exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm typecheck` → exit 0; `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` → exit 0.
- Changeset: none. `vitest.config.ts` is not in the package's `files[]` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`), so nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.
